name: Jingchu Robot
summary: Jingchu Robot is a Wuhan manufacturer of humanoid robots and core components, founded in April 2025. It develops linear-drive robot bodies, motion control and embodied intelligence systems. Its product range serves research, education, industry and service applications, including the compact Xiaochu robot with articulated arms and a wheeled lower body.
